integrity: The classification is proved analytically from the exact blockwise Knill--Laflamme criterion. The included finite checker only corroborates representative instances and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the explicit one-shot channel family with one protected qubit sector and \(m\) rank-one branches.
The integer \(z\) uses exact orthogonality; no approximate-error threshold is claimed.
Tensor powers, entanglement assistance, and asymptotic hybrid capacities are not classified.
title: Generic rank-one branch rotations preserve non-domination of hybrid quantum codes
